name: sand3d
tagline: Python library for writing 3D objects as code, optimized for LLM use
description: sand3d is a Python library that lets users define 3D objects through short programs. Each object is represented by a Python file that specifies its parts, shapes, materials, and joints, and can be rendered in Blender via its bpy API. The library is designed to be LLM-friendly, using concise code that fits within a few hundred tokens. It includes a dataset of 100,000 open‑source 3D assets written in this format, enabling developers, artists, and researchers to generate or modify 3D models programmatically.
